title: Why Scaling Agents Requires Organisational Design | Guy Podjarny and Simon Maple

segments.text: When you have a lot of people, they can
all be your hired amazing people.
They're very intelligent. But as the
scope of the task grows, it becomes a
lot more like managing organization. Do
we know to go and read to the right
document at the right time? Do we
remember our own selves from a year ago?
And so, a lot of these analogies apply
now to agents. And [music] some
organizational philosophy comes into how
do you make agents effective? From the
